description: This file contains the backend code for the ExamResult.aspx page, handling the display and update of user exam results within an online examination system. It manages session data, updates database records related to user's exam counts and total marks, and displays exam-related information.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, managing user exam result display and database updates.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, fetches session data, updates user statistics in database, and populates UI fields with exam data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to the login page.
